phase: Bounded metadata ranking and current-first-party evidence preflight
scopeBoundary: The true-unprocessed Priority C pool was fixed at 18 records after excluding production, closed/renovation, HARD-CASE, and canonical facility-space records with a formal disposition. Metadata ranked at most eight. Current first-party research began only with ranks 1-3 and stopped when three ADOPT candidates were found. This is preflight only: no source JSON, ranges, generated catalog/runtime artifact, fingerprint, production implementation, or deployment was created.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires a current/current-linked issuer-numbered map or seat list, a representative configuration supported by issuer evidence, a lossless complete printed set, and issuer-defined row/block ownership or subtotal evidence. Fixed seating, movability, wheelchair metadata, pit/stage variation, and a published-total difference are not standalone gates. Seat IDs, ownership, and reconciliation must never be invented from geometry or capacity.
